Not bad at all. Guess I can pull through
when I
put my mind to it.

I almost had it... I was so
close to
getting that win.

around?
We've gotta come up with an
even wilder plan.

text_block_list.text:
As I see Seiun Sky brimming with
confidence, I
can't help but feel she's
going to get the win next
time.

text_block_list.text:

already.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:

something
better.

text_block_list.text:

factor...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Seiun Sky mumbles quietly to herself.
